instruction: Disable the background cone visualization in VLC to achieve a cleaner, minimal video playback interface.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires disabling the background cone visualization in VLC (qt-bgcone=0). Evaluator uses existing check_qt_bgcone metric and get_vlc_config getter to read VLC configuration file and verify qt-bgcone setting is set to 0. Default value is 1 (enabled), so the agent must navigate to Tools > Preferences > Interface and disable 'Display background cone or art'. This is similar in complexity to the original task (changing a single VLC configuration setting).

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly extracts VLC config file containing qt-bgcone setting
Metric correctly parses config file and checks qt-bgcone value (default=1/enabled, expected=0/disabled)
Expected value (0) semantically matches instruction requirement to disable background cone
Postconfig appropriately restarts VLC to ensure settings are persisted to config file
Complete coverage: evaluator checks exactly what instruction requires (single setting change)
Edge case handling: metric correctly handles default value (1) when setting not found in config
